title: Southeast Asia PM2.5 forecast by province (latest 3-hour step)
description: One record per province in 11 Southeast Asian countries (351), from SERVIR Southeast Asia / ADPC AQ Tracker: PM2.5 average, minimum and maximum over the grid cells in the province at the 3-hourly forecast step closest to now, with an indicative US EPA category. A model forecast (NASA GEOS-CF, bias-corrected), not a station measurement. Republished by ADPC GRP with the step time on every record and the worst provinces last.
source: SERVIR Southeast Asia / ADPC AQ Tracker, from NASA GEOS-CF (bias-corrected); republished by ADPC GRP
cadence: a new 3-hourly forecast step every 3 hours; new runs daily
license: unstated (SERVIR Southeast Asia / ADPC public feed; confirm with the AQ Tracker team)
usage_notes: Southeast Asia only, µg/m³. The default returns the worst provinces; pass {limit: 351} for all. The category is indicative: US EPA categories are for 24-hour averages and this is one 3-hour step. A forecast, not a measurement: check forecast_time and valid_until. Credit: SERVIR Southeast Asia / ADPC AQ Tracker, NASA GEOS-CF.
